transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what brings me in is that I'm just exhausted, and it's in a way that sleep doesn't really fix. Just getting through a normal workday and... and then managing dinner at home, it all just feels much heavier than it should right now.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yes, I suppose I have. Most days lately, I just... I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling. It's almost like I'm already disappointed in the day before it even really starts, if that makes sense. It's just a very flat, down sort of mood that sticks with me.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you normally like to do?

No, not really. I usually love painting, and... well, I normally enjoy wandering through museum exhibits, too. But recently, I just leave my art supplies sitting there untouched. I just can't seem to make myself care enough to actually go or do any of it right now.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Yes, I have. I just keep replaying things in my head... like every missed family plan, or every tense conversation I've had with my husband lately. It's hard not to feel like I'm just letting everyone down right now. I feel like I'm failing as a wife, as a mother, and even at work as a manager. I just feel guilty that I'm not doing enough for anyone.
Are you still able to find pleasure in activities that you normally enjoy, even if you're not motivated to do them?

Like I mentioned a minute ago with my painting and the museum exhibits... it's really not just the motivation. Even if I were to force myself to sit down with my art supplies instead of leaving them untouched, or if someone dragged me to a gallery, I just... I don't think I'd get any joy out of it. I just can't seem to make myself care about those things right now, whether I'm doing them or not.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried lately?
No, not really. I mean, I'm feeling down and guilty, like I said, but I wouldn't say I'm feeling anxious or worried about things. It's more just... a heavy feeling, not a nervous one.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been about a month. Um, before this started, I was actually feeling the complete opposite—unusually energized and really driven. But then it just swung into this persistent low feeling. So, yeah, it's been about a month now of feeling this way.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, I haven't. I know I'm feeling really down right now, but I haven't had any thoughts about hurting myself or ending things. It hasn't been anything like that.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?

Yeah, I have. Actually, my staff has even noticed it. They mentioned that I'm slower to answer questions in our meetings lately. It's just... like there's this pause before I can really get my thoughts and words moving. So, yes, definitely a bit slower.
Have you lost any weight recently?

Um, yes, I think I have. I've just been picking at my meals lately, or... honestly, I'll just forget to eat lunch while I'm at work. I'm not trying to lose weight at all, but I have noticed that my skirts are fitting a little looser than they usually do.
Do you feel like you're resting or sleeping more than usual?

Actually, no, it's kind of the opposite. I'm sleeping less. Even when I get into bed at a reasonable hour now, I end up waking up around four or five in the morning. My mind just starts going, thinking about work and my marriage, and... once that happens, I'm just done sleeping. I can't fall back asleep after that.
Have you been feeling restless or fidgety lately?

No, not really. I haven't noticed feeling restless or... fidgety. Like I mentioned earlier, it's actually been more of the opposite for me—just feeling slower and a bit sluggish. So, no, I don't think I've been fidgety at all.
Have you noticed any changes in how restless or still you are when sitting or lying down?

Like I mentioned just a second ago, I'm really not restless at all. It's more that I'm just... very still and slow. My staff has actually noticed it, too. When we're sitting in meetings, they've pointed out that I'm a lot slower to answer questions. It's like there's this long pause before I can actually get my thoughts and my words moving. So, definitely no extra movement, just feeling bogged down.
Would you say your low mood and other symptoms are interfering with your daily life a lot, or are you still able to manage most things?

I'm still managing most things, but it's... it's definitely taking a toll. I'm still showing up for work every day, and I'm handling my responsibilities at home, but like I said, I'm just slower with everything. Decisions at work take me longer. And at home, I've been a lot less reliable with family plans. I've also kind of withdrawn from my art activities... the things that usually keep me connected to people. So I'm functioning, I guess, but it's just harder to do it all.
Would you describe your current low mood and symptoms as mild, moderate, or severe?
I'd say it's mild. I mean, it's definitely there, and like I said, it's making things harder, but I wouldn't call it severe. I'm still getting by. It's just a mild, steady kind of low.
Have you been withdrawing from social interactions or relationships with friends and family because of how you've been feeling?

I mean, mostly just what I mentioned a minute ago. I've backed away from my art group, and I haven't been great about keeping family plans lately. But other than that... no, not really. I'm not locking myself away or ignoring phone calls from my friends. I still talk to people at work and see my family. I'm just a bit less social than normal right now, I guess.
Would you say your low mood and other symptoms have been present for most of the day or only part of the day?

I guess I'm not entirely sure. I haven't really been tracking it hour by hour. It's just sort of this general feeling that's around, you know? But I couldn't say if it's there most of the day or just parts of it. It's just kind of... there.
How many days in the past month have you felt this low mood?

I really couldn't give you an exact number. It's not something I've been counting on a calendar. It's just been going on for a while now, but I don't know exactly how many days out of the month it's been.
Would you say that your symptoms have caused significant distress or impairment in your social, occupational, or other areas of functioning?

I mean, I'm still showing up for work and handling my responsibilities at home. It hasn't completely stopped me from functioning. But... I guess it is affecting things. I've noticed I'm a lot slower with making decisions lately, which isn't great for my job. And like I said a minute ago, I've been less reliable with family plans and I've pulled back from the art activities that usually keep me connected. So it's definitely having an impact, just... not totally derailing everything.
